about: Held-out set for mentat/word_stage.py, written 2026-10-30 BEFORE the stage ran, separate from sigma-ground's 18 adversarial questions (which the stage must not be tuned on). 'compute' items have an expected value in expected_units (hand arithmetic, 2 percent tolerance); 'decline' items need a fact the question does not give, or are not arithmetic, and are right only when the stage returns no value.

items.question: A cyclist rides at 18 km/h for 2.5 hours. How far does she go?
How many seconds are in 3 weeks?
If a snail crawls at 1.3 mm/s, how many meters does it cover in a day?
A printer prints 24 pages per minute. How many pages does it print in 8 hours?
Two cars start 240 km apart and drive toward each other at 70 km/h and 50 km/h. How long until they meet?
A tank holds 2000 liters and a pump removes 35 liters per minute. How many hours to empty it?
At 12 meters per second, how many seconds does a sprinter take to run 400 meters?
How many 330 mL cans does it take to fill a 20 liter bucket?
A 60 watt light bulb runs for 30 days. How many kilowatt-hours of energy does it use?
Each coin is 1.75 mm thick. How tall in meters is a stack of 1000 coins?
A car uses 6.5 liters of fuel per 100 km. How many liters does a 650 km trip take?
Light from the Sun takes 8.3 minutes to reach Earth, travelling at 3.0e8 m/s. How many kilometers is that?
How many years is 5 billion seconds?
A mouse's heart beats 600 times per minute. Over a life of 2 years, how many beats is that?
If you walk at 5 km/h, how many hours does it take to walk a marathon of 42.195 km?
A recipe uses 250 g of flour for 4 servings. How many grams of flour for 10 servings?
A jacket costs 80 dollars and is on sale for 15 percent off. What does it cost now?
A rope is 3.2 meters long. How many pieces of 40 centimeters can be cut from it?
A river flows at 4 km/h. How many meters does a leaf drift in 15 minutes?
A tap drips 2 drops per second and each drop is 0.05 mL. How many liters leak in a day?
The Moon is 384,000 km away and light travels at 300,000 km/s. How many seconds does its light take to reach us?
A hummingbird beats its wings 50 times a second. How many beats in 3 hours?
A tortoise walks at 0.3 km/h and a hare runs at 12 km/h over a 6 km course. By how many minutes does the hare finish first?
If one nanometer were stretched to one millimeter, how many kilometers tall would a 1.8 meter person be?
How many soup cans tall is the Eiffel Tower? A soup can is 10 cm tall.
How many days would it take to walk from London to Paris at 4 km/h?
What is the kinetic energy of hope at 3 meters per second?
What is the capital of France if I have 3 apples?
How many people live in a city as big as Paris if 12 people share each house?
How much does a 5 liter bucket of gold weigh in kilograms?
How far does light travel in 3 seconds?
If I eat 3 apples a day, how many calories do I eat in a year?
A train travels for 3 hours. How far did it go?
How many dollars is 10 meters?
Is 17 a good number for a 3 year old to have as a favourite?
What is the probability of rolling three sixes in a row with a fair die?
